momentum_aggregation: sum of preceding 60 per-code observed trading rows, excluding current row
normalization: 2 * (daily average percentile rank - daily mean percentile rank)
missing_policy: nonfinite residual -> NaN; missing momentum rank -> 0 before EWMA
relisting_reset: reset after more than 20 missing exchange-date ordinal steps
ewma_initialization: first available score in each listing segment
training_procedure: No supervised fit; definition selected on four Train development folds 2011-2014 only
economic_status: research candidate only; confirmation Net Sharpe negative; statistical adoption evidence insufficient
